heading.title: Send feedback
heading.description: Report a bug or an error, suggest something, or tell us what you think.

bug.label: Bug or error
bug.hint: Something does not work, or shows the wrong thing.

suggestion.label: Suggestion
suggestion.hint: An idea for something new, or something to do better.

other.label: Other feedback
other.hint: Anything else you want to tell us.

form.messageHint: For a bug: what you did, what happened, and what you expected.
form.emailHint: Only if you want a reply. You do not need an account to send feedback.
form.privacyVisitor: Only admins read feedback, together with the page you came from and your email address, if you give one.
form.privacyUser: Only admins read feedback, together with your name and the page you came from.

thanks.title: Thank you for your feedback
thanks.description: It went straight to the team behind The SaaS Harbor, who read everything that comes in.

errors.sendFailed: Your feedback could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.chooseKind: Choose what kind of feedback it is.
errors.email: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
errors.suspended: Your account is suspended, so you cannot send feedback.
errors.tooMuch: You have sent a lot of feedback. Try again later.
errors.busy: A lot of feedback came in just now. Try again later.
